coordinateConvention: faceId, faceIds and edgeIds are zero-based indices of the CURRENT referenced body. body.faceCount/edgeCount define the range. Counts alone do not identify spatial meaning. Do not guess face orientation. Rebuild may renumber topology; do not reuse IDs across revisions without reinspection.
